project_name: i'M On Social - Marketing Site Redesign
target_stack: Pure HTML5, Shared Vanilla CSS, Vanilla JavaScript (No React Framework)

positioning.tagline: The Relationship OS for Sales Teams
positioning.core_value_prop: Your CRM remembers the deal. i'M On Social remembers the person.

brand_rules.em_dash_policy: STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. Never use em dashes (—) anywhere in page copy. Use commas, hyphens with spaces (' - '), or separate sentences.

logo_files.rule: Do not create or invent alternate wordmarks or logos. Use only existing speech-bubble logo image files.

brand_rules.chat_widget_spacing: Reserve bottom-right corner (z-index 9999) for the i'M On Social live chat widget. Do not anchor fixed buttons or floating badges in the bottom-right 100px x 100px area.

navigation_bar.backdrop: backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: rgba(7, 11, 20, 0.85); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
navigation_bar.dropdown_menus: Desktop hover / focus-visible animated card panels; Mobile toggle full-screen overlay.

phone_mockup_frame.specs: rounded-[48px] border-[8px] border-[#2A3447] shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden bg-black
phone_mockup_frame.dynamic_island: w-[100px] h-[24px] bg-black rounded-full absolute top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20

footer.style: Compact multi-column accordion layout with collapsible dropdown headers on mobile
footer.script_requirement: Include third-party widget script in footer markup: <script src="https://app.imonsocial.com/api/w/FE2POg13.js" async></script>

demo_modal.title: Book a Demo with i'M On Social
demo_modal.compliance_checkbox: I agree to receive SMS updates and demos from i'M On Social. Message & data rates may apply.

homepage_blueprint.title: Your CRM Remembers the Deal. i'M On Social Remembers the Person.
homepage_blueprint.subtitle: The Relationship OS that turns automated follow-ups into genuine human connection. Powered by Live Jessi AI, instant lead queues, and voice memos.
homepage_blueprint.visual: Hero Phone Frame displaying live 'People to Talk to Today' view with relationship health indicators.

homepage_blueprint.headline: Built for Sales Reps Who Win on Relationships

items.name: People to Talk To Today
items.desc: Intelligent daily agenda showing exactly who to reach out to and why.

items.name: Jessi AI (Text & Live Voice)
items.desc: AI assistant texting in the rep's authentic voice and providing hands-free voice coaching.

items.name: Shared Lead Queue
items.desc: Speed-to-lead timers ensuring every internet lead is claimed within seconds.

items.name: Voice Memos to Notes
items.desc: Talk naturally after a conversation - AI auto-summarizes notes and schedules follow-ups.

items.name: Digital & 4x6 Printed Leave-Behind Cards
items.desc: QR-powered digital profiles paired with physical leave-behind cards for instant trust.

items.name: Website Chat & Voice Widget
items.desc: Allow web visitors to text, request an instant call, or chat directly with Jessi.

industry_pages_template.structure: Hero -> Industry Challenge vs Relationship OS Solution -> Phone Screenshots -> Tailored Playbook Features -> Industry Testimonial -> Demo CTA

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, modals) MUST contain data-testid attributes for automated testing.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_states: Interactive elements must transition border-color, background, or scale (1.02x) smoothly over 200ms.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.mobile_responsiveness: 100% mobile optimized with touch-friendly targets (minimum 44px height).
